messages:
lucy_sales: Heads-up 10: Globex reached out, wants BYO-CMK with HSM in their colo (Utimaco). Key policy: never export, monthly rotation, dual-control for master key ops. POC ask: validate latency and rotation workflow.

omar_se: Good context. We support KMIP + cloud KMS. Dual-control is trickier but doable: you can require an approval step before GenerateDataKey or Decrypt via their HSM policy. Need to confirm KMIP server supports operator auth.

globex_ciso: Important: must have remote attestation + HSM firmware ver, plus signed key wrapping logs. Also want per-request latency SLA (target <30ms for Encrypt/Decrypt). Can you provide encryption-at-rest diagram and proof we never see plaintext keys?

omar_se: Encryption model: service generates ephemeral DEKs, encrypts with customer CMK (Encrypt/Wrap) over KMIP or CloudKMS GenerateDataKey. We store only wrapped DEKs and metadata (key version, wrapping alg). No plaintext DEKs persist. We can provide architecture diagram and sequence diagram.

sara_security: We'll provide: (1) sequence diagram; (2) statement that we do not persist plaintext KEKs; (3) audit log samples with request IDs. We should also request their KMIP operator roles and cert chain for attestation.

lucy_sales: Pricing question: will there be an ongoing per-op surcharge for HSM-backed BYO keys or just an uplift on Dedicated/Private?

omar_se: Pricing model options: (A) infra uplift + per-request premium (for high QPS key ops) or (B) flat HSM add-on based on reserved throughput. For low QPS (<1000 ops/day) a flat uplift is easier. We'll propose both.

globex_ciso: We also need key rotation semantics: cannot decrypt old ciphertext after rotation unless rewrap performed. We need a laaS for rotation timeline and ability to perform emergency rollback to prior key version.

omar_se: Rotation options: immediate rewrap batch (synchronous) or lazy rewrap (on access) + background rewrap. We keep key version metadata so revert is possible if we keep older key versions accessible in HSM for a retention window. Emergency rollback runbook ok.

sara_security: Add to questionnaire: incident notification SLA (72h initial), key compromise timeline, and who can request emergency rollback. We'll need their org contacts for dual-control mapping.

lucy_sales: POC needs: test KMIP endpoint or cloud IAM role, sample non-prod data, and a simple load script for key ops tests. Want 10k ops to validate latency under load.

omar_se: We'll spin up a temporary env and run a perf test. Example AWS KMS config for Dedicated path we can share: 
```
provider: aws
kms_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMSAccess
key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234
region: us-west-2
```
For KMIP path we'll need endpoint and client cert.

deploy-bot: Provisioning: env "poc-globex-kms" started (id: env-9082). Do not exceed 5k ops/min until tests validated. :robot_face:

globex_ciso: We'll provide KMIP endpoint and operator cert today. Also confirm you can ingest signed attestation from HSM vendor.

omar_se: We can accept signed attestation files and include them in the security package. Note: some HSMs support remote attestation APIs (TPM-style) but we may need to validate format.

sara_security: Action items from Sec side: draft security Q answers, request vendor SOC/ISO, ask for KMIP cert chain, prepare rollback runbook template. (ETA 48h)

lucy_sales: Action items from Sales/SE: 1) share architecture + sample configs for KMIP and AWS KMS (omar) 2) perf test plan and estimate of uplift vs flat fee (lucy/omar) 3) schedule 30m with Globex + SE + Sec (lucy).

omar_se: ETA for config + architecture note: EOD tomorrow. Perf plan + estimate: 2 business days.

globex_ciso: Also need legal to confirm we can record per-operation logs for audit export. Who on Redwood legal handles this?

sara_security: I'll loop in legal after we document data retention and log export format.

lucy_sales: Thanks team. I'll follow up with meeting invite. :thumbsup:
